C0626.title: POS Machine Cash-Out and Credit Card Repayment Scheme Leads to Eight-Year Prison Sentence
C0626.summary: Defendant Han used POS machines to facilitate cash-outs and repay credit card balances for others, illegally engaging in fund settlement operations and disrupting market order. The Xinmi Court convicted him of illegal business operations and sentenced him to eight years in prison. The case reveals the severe legal consequences of using POS machines for fictitious transactions to extract cash.
